_help: Hand-set salary ranges (LPA) that beat the web lookup. Key: '<linkedin company slug>|<family>|<level>' — family: swe, frontend, fullstack, mobile, devops, data, ml, qa, security, erp; level: l1, l2, l3. Use '*' for any family/level, e.g. 'razorpay|*|l1'. The slug is the part after linkedin.com/company/ on the company's LinkedIn page.

_example_razorpay|swe|l1.note: keys starting with _ are ignored; remove the _ to use
